description: Provision of space for the establishment of new Courts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the National Action Plan for Anti-Corruption (2025-2029), the need to establish several new High Courts has been identified as a matter of urgency in order to implement the functions assigned to the Ministry of Justice and National Integration. Accordingly, the Cabinet having been informed by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government that his Ministry will take steps to hand over the buildings located at the following addresses, currently under the custody of the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to the Ministry of Justice and National Integration, to establish 04 High Courts expeditiously, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the same:No.B 88, Gregory’s Road, Colombo 07.No.C 76, Baudhdhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07.No.B 108, Wijerama Road, Colombo 07.No.B 12, Stanmore Cresent, Colombo 07.
